text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer!
It's a wonderful morning, isn't it?
choice_data_list: O-Oh, someone's in a good mood!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! On our day off, Fine-san invited me to an Irish restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The lamb shepherd's pie was divine♪
Both of us even went for seconds!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You should come with me next time! You're guaranteed to fall in love with it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart enjoyed some delicious Irish cuisine
and seemed to have spent a truly fulfilling day off!
